recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-angle close-up portrait of a young child with a serious expression, characterized by warm, golden-hour lighting and a soft-focus background. The composition features a prominent script-style title in the lower-left corner and a standard industry advisory label in the lower-right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's direct eye contact creates an intimate, confrontational connection.
Warm skin tones contrast against the cool blue and white stripes of the clothing.
The soft-focus background isolates the subject's face as the primary focal point.
coreInvariants: Extreme close-up framing focusing on the eyes and brow.
Handwritten-style script typography for the main title.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face occupies approximately 70% of the frame, positioned slightly off-center to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's left eye (viewer's right) serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's gaze, moves down to the script text in the bottom left, and finishes at the advisory label in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the blurred background areas around the head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm amber and golden skin tones define the overall mood.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark navy blue with white pinstripes in the clothing provides a structural contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white used for the script typography and the advisory label text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm tones with a soft, slightly hazy value range that mimics vintage film photography.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or overly cool primary colors.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with varying line weights.
letterConstructionRules: Fluid, connected strokes mimicking natural handwriting.
Slightly irregular baseline to enhance the 'hand-drawn' feel.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'P' with a wide, sweeping top loop.
Lowercase 't' with a long, horizontal crossbar that extends over adjacent letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A fluid, expressive script paired with a rigid, geometric sans-serif (for the advisory label).
graphicDevices: Parental advisory box in the bottom right corner.

preserve: The white color of the text
avoid: Standard blocky sans-serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, brush-like motion of the original lettering.
Provides a similar casual, energetic handwritten feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-angle, close-up portrait of a young boy with a serious expression. Use warm, golden-hour lighting and a shallow depth of field to blur the background. The boy should be wearing a navy blue pinstriped shirt.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a two-line white script title in the bottom-left corner using a brush-style font. Place a standard black and white parental advisory logo in the bottom-right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and nostalgic?
Is the focus sharp on the eyes while the background is blurred?
Does the script text look organic and handwritten?
Is the composition tightly framed on the face?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the warm color grade
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the child to avoid identity replication

mustAchieve: Emotional weight through the subject's gaze

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the eyes are the sharpest point of the image.
Check that the white text is clearly legible against the background.
Verify the color balance leans toward amber/gold rather than blue/green.
Confirm the framing is an extreme close-up.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a vintage-style childhood portrait with organic, white script lettering in the lower third to create a sense of personal history and modern artistry.
